related_questions.snippet: Are public defender's "real" lawyers? Absolutely! All Deputy Public Defenders are full-fledged attorneys who are members of the State Bar and have been licensed to practice law in the State of California.
related_questions.title: Are public defender's "real" lawyers? - Nevada County

related_questions.question: What disqualifies you from a public defender?
related_questions.snippet: Defendants who cannot afford legal counsel only have the right to free legal counsel if the charge carries a risk of a jail or prison sentence. Thus, a defendant charged with a minor offense such as a traffic violation will probably not be appointed a public defender.
related_questions.title: The Right to a Public Defender in a Criminal Law Case - Justia

related_questions.question: What are the odds of winning a case with a public defender?
related_questions.snippet: In both Federal and large State courts, conviction rates were the same for defendants represented by publicly financed and private attorneys. Approximately 9 in 10 Federal defen- dants and 3 in 4 State defendants in the 75 largest counties were found guilty, regardless of type of attorney.
related_questions.title: Defense Counsel in Criminal Cases - Bureau of Justice Statistics

related_questions.question: Has a public defender ever won a case?
related_questions.snippet: You can have a successful case with a public defender and even win, but your chances are better with a private attorney who has the time, resources, and experience to devote to your case.
